messages:
Ana (platform): Quick flag 1: we discovered ~75m of late telemetry touching agg-hours in ap-southeast. Proposing a targeted reprocess (shards 101-103) with a preflight that shows cost, slot conflicts, and a risk score before we apply any quota/affinity changes.
Marco (ops): sounds good. prefer canary=1 shard then ramp. ops runbook change: add `--affinity=dedi-apse2` option when we want strict isolation. Also need estimated cost per shard.
Terry (eng-runtime): Can confirm: affinity to dedi pool avoids noisy neighbors but causes model cold-starts. We'll simulate warmup and include `--kv-warmup=true` for canary. Simulation should assume TTL=12m for cache churn estimate.
Lina (console): UI idea: single modal preflight that returns: {preflight_id, shards, est_cost_usd, risk:low/med/high, conflicts:[route->timeslot], recommended_actions}. Should console mutate any state? I'd vote simulate-only.
Ana (platform): simulate-only for preflight, operator must opt-in to apply affinity/quota. Also require preflight to emit telemetry: preflight.requester, preflight.estimated_cost_usd, preflight.risk. Marco can own ticket for implementing runbook changes.
preflight-bot: preflight queued: preflight-5182003333 (simulate shards:[101]) status=queued
Marco (ops): I will own runbook and canary. snippet for apply if all looks good:
```
redwoodctl tenant annotate acme-apse --labels affinity=dedi-apse2
redwoodctl backfill start --shards 101 --cohort canary --kv-warmup=true --tag apse-late-5182
```
Terry (eng-runtime): I'll add the KV-warmup flag default for affinity runs and open a small PR linking platform ticket. Will also make simulator include transient SLO hit probability.
Lina (console): I'll prototype the modal and call `POST /api/v1/backfill/preflight`. It will be auth-guarded and redact tenant GUIDs.
Ana (platform): Action items: Terry add warmup + simulator; Lina prototype preflight UI + API call; Marco update runbook and own rollout. Aim to run micro-canary tonight 23:30 UTC. +1s?
Marco (ops): +1. I'll be oncall for canary monitoring.
Terry (eng-runtime): +1. I'll monitor SLO signals and KV metrics.
Lina (console): +1. will post screenshots in #console-proto.
Ana (platform): closing thread 1. will post ticket link when created.
